image_description: A full-body side view of a green iguana walking on grass. The iguana has a prominent dorsal crest, a large dewlap, and distinct black banding on its body and tail. The background consists of tall green reeds or grass.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is large and triangular with a prominent dewlap (loose skin fold) hanging from the throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head shape is clearly triangular and the dewlap is visible hanging from the throat area.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are large with round pupils and golden irises.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eye is visible, appearing large with a light-colored iris consistent with the description, though pupil shape is hard to resolve at this resolution.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: A large circular subtympanic shield (scale) is present below the tympanum.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The characteristic large circular scale behind the jaw angle is clearly visible.
The torso appears thick and muscular, consistent with a robust body.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Coloration is bright green in juveniles, becoming darker green to greyish-green in adults with broad black bands on the body and tail.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The iguana displays green coloration with distinct dark/black vertical bands on the flank and tail.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Row of enlarged, spine-like scales running from the nape along the midline of the back to the tail base, forming a serrated crest.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dorsal crest is highly prominent, running continuously from the neck down the spine.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Skin is covered in small, granular scales with larger, plate-like scales on the head.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Texture analysis shows finer scales on the body and larger, smoother plates on the head/jaw area.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are long and muscular with five clawed digits on each foot.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While limbs are visible, the feet are partially obscured by grass and the angle makes counting exactly five clawed digits impossible to verify strictly.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and longer than body, used for balance and defense.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail extends beyond the frame but is clearly longer than the snout-to-vent length and appears laterally flattened.
